ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels located on the lateral lobes versus 55% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle region and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly triangular high-intensity white blobs on the outer lobes, heavily fragmented by low-intensity mottling and dense speckling concentrated near the central notch and the leading edge contact point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge, characterized by sharp, irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 12 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex curvature sweeping upward from the medial notch toward the distal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, non-linear pixel disruptions visible as scratches on the mid-right high-intensity field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface mottling and micro-scarring across all high-intensity regions; no evidence of major structural amputations or large-scale parasitic lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark spot is visible near the distal tip of the left lobe within the white field.
